summary: Investigated apps/app test failures, identifying a WorkspaceInspector test failure caused by a missing `apiVersion` field on a mocked extension. Set `apiVersion: 1` on the test fixture to satisfy the registry's version check, then updated documentation (`docs/project-configuration.md`, `docs/extensions.md`) to clarify extension activation, registry catalog entries, and the distinction between Pi's "Extensions" concept and `GizmoServerExtension`.
decisions: WorkspaceInspector test fixture must declare `apiVersion: 1` on the mocked extension definition so the registry's `definition.apiVersion !== descriptor.apiVersion` check passes and the inspector tabs render.

Docs rewrite: Gizmo extensions are activated via the registry catalog (per-workspace enable/disable, no workspace detection in Gizmo); Pi's "Extensions" concept is treated as separate from `GizmoServerExtension`, with client runtime loading delivered over the agent connection.
errors: WorkspaceInspector test failed with `expected true, received null` for `[data-ui="test-domain-panel-tab"]` because the mocked extension definition lacked `apiVersion`, causing the registry to skip activation; fixed by adding `apiVersion: 1` to the fixture.
Initial docs edit to `docs/project-configuration.md` failed because the `oldText` did not match exactly; a follow-up read confirmed the actual content and a corrected edit succeeded.
